facts.fact: The Bank of South Sudan launched on 10 October 2025 the country's first electronic Interbank Payment and Settlement System, enabling real-time bank-to-bank transactions in place of paper-based manual processing.

SSD.note: No consumer protection rule or redress stated.
EAC and AfDB welcomed the system but no participation in a regional system is stated.
No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.
Mobile money integration is only expected; the system is bank-to-bank.
No tax or fee payment stated.
